cards.title: Hidden Power
cards.instruction: Act publicly modest while making choices as though you control the outcome.

cards.title: Not That Subject
cards.instruction: Choose one subject you cannot let the scene reach. Redirect whenever the conversation gets close.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I only made a couple of bookings. Your car's going to the garage with the cafe, and I've chosen us a table for breakfast.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why does my car need a garage?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Unlimited toast there. I've ordered you the full breakfast; no miserable one-slice business.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll look at the car while you order.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The order's in. I've booked a taxi to take us straight to the cafe entrance; you can choose our breakfast cocktails on the way.

reason: Replace explicit outcome boilerplate with a modest social contribution and concrete decisions. Preserve distinct loyalty, surrender, blame diversion, forbidden subject and protective-lie mechanisms; make B contribution determine the next tactic.
